maps.name: Mammoth Valley
maps.blurb: One long road through the meadow. Learn the robots.

maps.name: Glacier Pass
maps.blurb: A shorter road and a frozen lake where you can't build. Tougher robots.

maps.name: Volcano Ridge
maps.blurb: Two portals. Lava everywhere. Two Prime Walkers at once.

maps.name: River Delta
maps.blurb: The river splits the valley. Only one bridge crosses it, and you can't build on water.

maps.name: Desert Citadel
maps.blurb: Dunes and ruins crowd a short road. Shield Bots arrive early.

maps.name: Copper Canyon
maps.blurb: Two portals in the mines. Two Siege Crawlers at the end.
